capture.local_texture: retain fine wall grain, skin creases, knuckle color variation, glass thickness, liquid texture and subtle sensor noise
capture.phone_hdr: restrained computational tone mapping with natural tonal separation
capture.shadow_processing: do not lift every dark region toward the wall midtone; preserve natural tonal separation

asymmetry_sources: a compact connected shadow behind and left of the product
the hand entering from the lower edge
composition.subject_anchor_priority: One smaller hand-cup unit at width 0.16-0.20 and height 0.23-0.29 is supported by a slender fine-boned hand under a 2-6 degree downward camera; no enlarged alternative exists.

coupling_rules: Camera working distance remains 105-145cm and pitch remains 2-6 degrees downward.
The cup and a slender fine-boned hand share one near focal plane and one upper-right direct-window source.
When the selected container includes a straw it is colorless optically clear plastic with neutral transmitted wall light; otherwise no straw is invented.
The wall remains 100-180cm behind with lower detail and moderate optical softness.
The reviewed V4 contrast of 1.10 remains unchanged.
display_name: 인스타 에디토리얼 · 화이트 직사광 핸드헬드 · 정제 비율 v5

environment.background_plane: real warm-white plaster wall 100-180cm behind the held product, with attenuated texture and moderate optical softness
environment.sun_patch_shape: broad partial tonal changes from window frames and unseen furniture outside the frame, not one sharp connected silhouette
environment.surface_character: fine irregular plaster visible only at reduced background contrast and acuity

forbidden: low or upward camera and visible cup underside
paper sleeve, holder, wrap or cuff
wall as sharp as the near hand-cup plane
oversized hero product or wide-angle looming
broad rugged palm or oversized hand
thick swollen fingers or coarse knuckles
human_rendering.light_response: sun-facing skin is warm and bright while turning planes retain neutral density and microtexture; no glowing fill
human_rendering.skin_texture: fine natural lines, narrow-palm anatomy, tapered fingers, subtle knuckle structure, ordinary nail edges and small color variation without rugged exaggeration or beauty retouch

lighting.ambient_fill: low neutral room bounce plus subtle off-frame furniture color and exposure variation
lighting.highlight_behavior: protect transparent-container highlights while retaining bright direct-sun sparkle and local contrast; no flat white clipping
lighting.shadow_description: broad softened partial wall shadows with gradual density falloff; no sharp connected cup-hand silhouette
lighting.shadow_temperature: slightly cooler and more neutral than the warm sunlit areas
lighting.source: unfiltered direct late-afternoon sun entering through a real window with no curtain or diffusion panel

material_rules.glass: Show real thickness at the rim and weighted base, restrained specular highlights, transmitted green light and small refraction changes; the glass shadow may contain lighter transmitted areas.
material_rules.plastic: clear cup and lid show thin neutral reflections; a selected straw is colorless optically clear plastic with neutral transmitted wall light, never gray, green, beige, black, metallic or opaque

hard_fail: exact product count differs from one
product width exceeds 0.20 or height exceeds 0.29
hand is oversized, broad-palmed, rugged, thick-fingered or coarse-knuckled
a required straw is gray, green, beige, black, metallic or opaque instead of colorless optically clear plastic
a straw is invented when the selected source or container policy says none
camera pitch is below 2 degrees or an upward/low-angle reading appears
paper sleeve, holder, wrap or cuff appears
wall reads close, sharp or in the same focal plane as the cup
skin is waxy, airbrushed, uniform or anatomically malformed
contrast crushes hand or beverage shadows, or clips the white wall
